snippet.description:
Plus Two Chemistry Quick Revision 🔥
Complete Haloalkanes and Haloarenes chapter covered in one-shot revision — based on NCERT + Kerala DHSE syllabus.
Perfect for Board Exam 2025 and NEET/JEE aspirants who want concept clarity and quick recall 💯

📘 What’s Included:
• Classification & Nomenclature of Haloalkanes and Haloarenes
• Nature of C–X bond
• Mechanism of nucleophilic substitution (SN1 & SN2)
• Elimination reactions (β-elimination)
• Chemical properties of haloalkanes & haloarenes
• Environmental effects of halogenated compounds
• Important NCERT Intext & Exercise Questions
• Quick Summary + PYQs ✅

🎯 Ideal for last-minute revision and concept strengthening
💬 Comment your doubts — Team RK Nex will guide you!
❤️ Subscribe for more One-Shot Chemistry Revision Series
